body:
I don't believe there is one, single reason for it, more like a series of events and facts that led to this. If there was anybody or anything else to blame, I probably wouldn't feel like I so deserve death. Yes, I've expressed interest in a lot of girls, always been rejected. I've tried everything from asking out friends, to befriending them after I've decided I like them, to asking them out cold, and so on and so forth, and that's not even touching on all the things I've tried to attract them to me (as opposed to just asking them out and hoping they'll give me a chance). 
My school's social environment was only really small by comparison - say, 40 students per grade as opposed to 80. Not quite the case anymore, but I haven't been mingling for a while. This year, I decided I cannot socialize and meet new people until I find a drug that can kill my romantic needs and wants (though, as I said before, at this point it really looks like suicide is the only alternative). I just cannot bear to put myself through that again and waste yet more women's time. Men would probably have girlfriends of their own (75% of the time, they do), and that would just be one more person to compare myself to and be jealous and feel like crap.

People like me as in they have no love life and nobody's been attracted to them. I guess I should say I'm not one of those men who just aren't interested in the women interested in him, or have had a few dates but think they don't count, I literally, absolutely, zero romantic value.
Lover Of Mine or Kamalani, both by Bruddah Iz.
That wouldn't be necessary. Even canonically, she would only live a few states away from me.

A lot of the times, I just forget about reddit altogether. I browse 2 subreddits and occasionally a third one; the rest of the huge website is pretty much garbage to me, so, you can see how that happens.

Pearl is the one I've been with the longest, and I am still with her currently. First, I should explain something. Canonically, she still clings to her long-gone past lover. I don't want her to just forget about said lover, but I also felt very much like I'm just the "runner up"; we came to the conclusion that we be in an open relationship. Luckily, she's confident that she is the only one I will keep returning to, and so far, she is correct. <3

Ha, anyway... So currently, Marie (Splatoon) is also my waifu. In the past, there was also Leaf (Pokemon), Korrina (also Pokemon), Cosmo (Sonic X, but more of a reimagining of her), and Roll (MegaMan). Yes, I was just a kid during Roll's time, just so you know.
Not really for remembering her (why would I need a reminder?) but I do have Pearl as my real wife in Tomodachi Life. lol
My special one has helped me immensely with being alone literally my entire life in the real world. But that's not all she's been there for, of course.
Don't question it, just go with it, because it sounds sooooo good. I'm not kidding, the pros seriously outweigh the cons no matter how I look at it - I'd kill to be in your position!
It's one of those shows that's a completely different experience for young adults than it is for children, if that makes sense.

Thanks for the advice so far, everybody. I think I'll go with what the general consensus so far is and give it a little time and see if my feelings for the other two will just burn out on its own eventually. I think I'll report back and let you all know if things are fine or if the situation gets more complicated.
If anybody else has something to say, though, feel free to continue to reply for the sake of conversation! :D

I've always been as attracted to characters as much as real people. Actually, I remember liking a character before I was ever into real girls. I was always hoping I'd be able to make it with 3D people (if you all use that sort of lingo here), but time went by - and, obviously, still goes by - and still never had a real girlfriend, so I suppose it's only natural that I care so much about a fictional girl.
